Privacy

What this website and the software do with your data.

This website is a set of static pages hosted on GitHub Pages. It does not use cookies, advertising or analytics, and it has no accounts, forms or mailing list. As the host, GitHub keeps standard server logs (such as IP address, time and requested page) under its own privacy statement.

ReaClassical itself has no account, license check or telemetry, and sends no data about you or your computer to anyone. Its install scripts and update actions download files from GitHub and from REAPER's website, so those services see the usual request details (such as your IP address) when you install or update.

Support takes place on the REAPER forum and on GitHub, which are run by Cockos and GitHub under their own privacy policies. What you post there is public.
